title: Pico REPL vs Script Workflow
description: Three ways to run code on a Pico, separated by one question: what is still running after you pull the cable out?
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Raspberry Pi Pico, MicroPython, and the Moving Rainbow Kit

educational.audience: Students moving from experiments to a finished project

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given the Pico's REPL prompt, a saved test file, and a saved main.py file, the learner explains the difference between typing a command interactively and running a script automatically at power-up.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click each panel for what that mode is for, then power cycle and watch which light comes back
pedagogical.assessment: Ask which mode a battery-powered demo needs, and why the other two fail.
